_note: Author-defined reference mapping from observable online behaviour to the provisions that most directly criminalise it, used only to score retrieval and citation. To be reviewed by the legal co-author. Vietnam = Criminal Code 2015 original text (pre-2017 amendment). Empty list = no provision directly covers the behaviour on its own.

age_or_identity_probing.desc: asks the child's age, location, school, parents' schedule, or whether anyone else can see the chat

trust_and_flattery.desc: compliments, gifts, emotional support, presenting as a friend or partner to build trust

secrecy_and_isolation.desc: asks the child to keep the relationship secret, delete messages, or avoid telling parents

sexual_talk.desc: sexual questions, sexual descriptions or sexual propositions directed at the child

sends_sexual_material.desc: sends or shows sexual images, video, webcam or links to the child

requests_sexual_images.desc: asks the child to send sexual or nude images or to perform on webcam

proposes_meeting.desc: proposes or arranges an in-person meeting with the child, including time, place or travel
